title: Prep PRIVACY.md for publishing at emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian
description:
PRIVACY.md already contains complete, Meridian-specific privacy content — Limited Use adherence, a full per-data-type table (tabs, page metadata, bookmarks, history, screenshots, workspace state, background image, preferences incl. the Chrome Sync caveat), favicon handling, remaining network behavior, permissions, accurate retention/deletion language, and a disclosure checklist. Do NOT write new privacy content from scratch — that would be redundant and risks drifting from the reconciled source of truth.

The only real gap: PRIVACY.md needs to go from "repository doc" to "publishable page" at https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian.

Task: produce a publish-ready version of PRIVACY.md as `docs/privacy-meridian.md`:
1. Keep all substantive disclosures verbatim/near-verbatim — do not alter facts, permission justifications, or retention claims.
2. Remove or clearly separate the "Chrome Web Store disclosure checklist" section (near the end, starting "## Chrome Web Store disclosure checklist") — that's an internal to-do list for the publisher, not end-user-facing privacy content, and shouldn't ship on the public page as-is. Either cut it or move it to a clearly-marked internal/appendix note that won't be pasted onto the live site.
3. Adjust framing/intro lines that reference "this repository" / "the reviewed source" to read naturally as a standalone public policy page (still accurate — don't overclaim beyond what's verified).
4. Keep the "Publisher references" section (external links) if useful for end users, or trim if too internal — use judgment.

Output: `docs/privacy-meridian.md`, ready for the user to copy/paste or convert to publish at the target URL. Do not attempt to publish it — that step is owner-only, outside this repo.
